name: gmail-imap
description: Your Gmail, read over IMAP with an app password: no Google Cloud project needed. Read-only: the mailbox is opened for reading and nothing is ever sent, moved, deleted or marked as read.

requires.help: Make an app password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (your account needs 2-Step Verification). Save it in that file as { "address": "you@gmail.com", "appPassword": "abcd efgh ijkl mnop" } and run chmod 600 on the file. Never use your normal Google password. An app password can do far more than read mail, so read extractors/gmail-imap/README.md first.

connect.note: Signing in to Gmail once to check the app password. Use this or the `gmail` extractor, not both: they read the same mail.
